description: Send conversions to Pinterest server-side — purchases, sign-ups, leads, add-to-carts or any of Pinterest’s 22 events — so Pinterest attributes them to the ads that caused them and conversion campaigns can optimise. Pass ordinary emails, phones and names: they are normalised Pinterest’s way and SHA-256 hashed on our server before they reach Pinterest. Every event needs something to match on: an email, a mobile ad id (maid), or BOTH ipAddress and userAgent — refused here otherwise. Pass eventId (your order or event id) if the site also runs the Pinterest tag, or the same conversion is counted twice. test:true makes Pinterest validate the events and record NOTHING — use it first. The reply counts what Pinterest PROCESSED, not what was sent, and names every failed event. Spends nothing, 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

customData.description: value, currency, orderId, contentIds, contents[{id,itemPrice,quantity}], numItems, contentName, contentCategory, contentBrand, searchString

eventId.description: the dedupe key shared with the browser tag — use the order id

eventSourceUrl.description: page URL where the event happened

eventTime.description: ISO timestamp or Unix epoch; default now

user.description: email, phone, firstName, lastName, gender (f/m/n), dateOfBirth, city, state, zip, countryCode, externalId, maid, ipAddress, userAgent, clickId (the _epik cookie). Plain values are hashed here; a 64-hex digest passes through.

name: send_pinterest_ads_conversions
title: Send conversions to Pinterest (Conversions API)
